death.attack.essentialcraft5.mru_dischar.zh: %1$s被%2$s的 MRU 特斯拉线圈电死了

death.attack.essentialcraft5.mru_dischar.en: %1$s was electrocuted by %2$s's MRU Coil while fighting %3$s
death.attack.essentialcraft5.mru_dischar.zh: %1$s在与%3$s战斗时被%2$s的 MRU 特斯拉线圈电死了

message.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.no_acce.en: This MRU Coil belongs to %s. Only its owner and players on its whitelist can open it
message.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.no_acce.zh: 这是%s的 MRU 特斯拉线圈，只有放下它的人和白名单上的人能打开

message.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.no_acce.en: No player placed this MRU Coil, so it can't be opened
message.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.no_acce.zh: 这台 MRU 特斯拉线圈不是玩家放下的，打不开

message.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.warning.en: Warning: you are inside %s's MRU Coil range. It is about to fire, get out!
message.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.warning.zh: 警告：你进入了%s的 MRU 特斯拉线圈射程，马上就要放电，快离开！

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.status.acti.en: Targets it can see within a %s-block sphere around the coil get zapped
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.status.acti.zh: 以线圈为中心、半径 %s 格的球里，看得见的目标都会挨电

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.status.acti.en: Each target hit costs %s MRU; misses cost nothing
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.status.acti.zh: 每打中一个目标花 %s MRU，没打中不花

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.status.inco.en: It needs a base of 25 plating blocks laid as a 7×7 rounded cross under the coil (below any coil bases)
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.status.inco.zh: 线圈下面（隔着基座）要有 25 块护板摆成的 7×7 十字圆

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.status.inco.en: See the Tesla chapter of the research book for the layout
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.status.inco.zh: 怎么摆见研究手册的「特斯拉」一章

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.status.reds.en: It stops while it gets a redstone signal and resumes as soon as the signal is gone
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.status.reds.zh: 通着红石信号就停机，信号撤掉马上恢复

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.status.no_m.zh: 每打中一个目标要 %s MRU

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.status.no_m.en: Put a bound gem in the gem slot to draw MRU from elsewhere
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.status.no_m.zh: 在宝石格里放一颗绑好的绑定宝石，从别处拉 MRU 过来

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.status.unkn.en: The structure hasn't been checked yet, or part of it is in an unloaded chunk
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.status.unkn.zh: 结构还没检查过，或者有一部分在还没加载的区块里

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.players.on..en: It attacks players who are not on its whitelist (never the player who placed it)
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.players.on..zh: 现在会打白名单以外的玩家（放下它的人永远不打）

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.players.on..en: It attacks intruders: players standing where the player who placed it may build but they may not, such as in that player's claim without trust (never whitelisted players or the player who placed it)
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.players.on..zh: 现在会打闯进来的人：站在放下它的人能动、自己却没有权限的地方的玩家（比如进了领地却没被信任；白名单上的人、放下它的人不打）

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.players.off.en: It only attacks monsters, never players
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.players.off.zh: 现在只打怪，不打任何玩家

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.players.rul.en: Players are warned first; players it can't see, players near the world spawn and players who just respawned after a coil death are spared
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.players.rul.zh: 打玩家之前先警告；看不见的、在世界出生点附近的、刚被线圈打死又重生的不打

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.players.loc.en: Only the player who placed it can switch this
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.players.loc.zh: 只有放下它的人能切换

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.players.no_.en: No player placed this coil, so it has no owner
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.players.no_.zh: 这台线圈不是玩家放下的，没有主人

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.players.no_.en: A coil without an owner only attacks monsters
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.players.no_.zh: 没有主人的线圈只打怪、不打玩家

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.players.dis.en: Coils in this world never attack players
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.players.dis.zh: 这个世界里的线圈不打玩家

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.slot.gem.1.en: Put in a bound gem; the coil draws MRU from where it is bound
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.slot.gem.1.zh: 放一颗绑好的绑定宝石，线圈从它绑定的地方拉 MRU

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.slot.list.1.en: Players on it are never attacked and can open this screen (view only)
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.slot.list.1.zh: 名单上的人不挨电，还能打开这个界面（只能看）

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.slot.locked.en: Only the player who placed it can change this
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.slot.locked.zh: 只有放下它的人能拿放

tooltip.essentialcraft5.player_list.usag.zh: 对着别的玩家右键：把他写上去

tooltip.essentialcraft5.player_list.usag.en: Craft it on its own: clear the list
tooltip.essentialcraft5.player_list.usag.zh: 单独放进工作台：清空名单

message.essentialcraft5.player_list.adde.en: You are now on the list

message.essentialcraft5.player_list.alre.en: You are already on the list

message.essentialcraft5.player_list.remo.en: You have been removed from the list

message.essentialcraft5.player_list.not_.en: You are not on the list

message.essentialcraft5.player_list.full.en: The list is full (%s players at most)

structure.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.base.en: Magic, pale, mithriline or demonic plating, or void stone (any color)
structure.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.base.zh: 魔力 / 淡青 / 米斯莱 / 恶魔护板或虚空石（颜色随意）

structure.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.harde.en: MRU Coil Base (stack any number, +2 range each)
structure.essentialcraft5.mru_coil.harde.zh: MRU 特斯拉线圈基座（可叠多层，每层射程 +2）
